items.title: Wall Street Expects Anthropic's Committed $900B Debt to Be Junk
items.summary:
💬 Misleading title, some inaccuracies in the article (WSJ of all places). Anthropic does have $900B or so of spending commitments (NOT on the balance sheet or income statement) and is expected to issue some debt (borrow at least some portion of it from somebody) but it does NOT mean it has $900B debt right now which is rated junk. Also, this $900B spending committed is over the next 20 years (2045 I think? It's in the S1 somewhere), and "only" $450 over the next 5 years, and less than $100B over the next 12 months. Still crazy numbers, but not "$900B over the next couple years" as quoted in the article.

items.title: Show HN: Hyper Elements – Agents build emails, PDFs, images with 70% less tokens
items.summary: We built Hyper Elements. A open source content engine for agents. It lets them build emails, PDFs or images in React using much fewer tokens. The agent writes content, our engine handles the layout and markup. It also tells the agent what the problems are in the content and how to fix them. We tested it by giving Claude Code a brief and run it 5 times with different libraries like Hyper Elements, React Email and MJML. Each run, Hyper Elements used fewer tokens and produced a passing email much faster. The benchmark is also open source in the repo.
